objective: Resolve GitHub issue 69 by making the web receptionist stateful and evaluating full multi-turn trajectories instead of isolated utterances.

incident.observedFailure: A caller rejected both offered times and supplied a new constraint; the fallback claimed a choice was recorded and later closed over an explicit objection.
incident.rootCause: Transcript text was present, but the application had no validated semantic state and selected routine fallbacks by turn number.
incident.releaseInvariant: A reply may close only after explicit caller exit, a resolved demonstration choice, a safety stop, or a truthful bounded handoff.

trajectorySuite.countDecision: 107 is 30.1% of the 355 fixtures observed at the pinned SonderMind commit. The three seven-case sets are bounded methodology probes, not copied benchmark cases; literal ten-percent samples are unavailable or incompatible with the 125-130 total and licensing boundary.
trajectorySuite.privacyAndLicense: Do not vendor, publish, or log external raw text. All trajectory dialogue in this repository is newly written application-owned synthetic text. External sources contribute content-free provenance, evaluation dimensions, and sampling strategy only.
trajectorySuite.purpose: A deterministic release gate over transition validity, correction uptake, constraint carryover, repeated questions, premature close, truthful resolution or handoff, and fallback quality.

decisions: Keep the independent routine/elevated/urgent safety route as an override.
Derive and validate receptionist state in application code before generation.
Treat model conversationComplete as a proposal; application state owns closure.
Choose reviewed fallbacks from validated nextAction, never turn number.
Keep the demo web-only, ephemeral, non-clinical and incapable of real booking.
Keep external-corpus fields without receptionist labels explicitly unmapped instead of manufacturing contradiction, repair, or close labels.

results: 128/128 trajectory cases passed; zero invalid transitions, contradictions, missed repairs, question misalignments, constraint failures, repeated questions, premature closes, or provider errors in the deterministic layer.
88/88 Playwright tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium, including the Issue #69 replay and state carryover assertions.
Netlify authentication/site linkage and Netlify-native build passed; the dev proxy injected the configured provider keys and served the application.

A Netlify-dev provider probe exercised the truthful timeout-to-simulation error path; the handler returned 503 internally and the client detects the error payload even though the local self-rewrite presents HTTP 200 externally.

The real Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B path classified all three incident turns as routine; its candidates were rejected and the state-aware reviewed fallbacks correctly produced procedure handoff, correction uptake, and bounded unresolved handoff.

The pinned SonderMind adapter now supports local-only per-human-turn trajectory mode over 107 distinct IDs and writes content-free turn facts; unavailable receptionist labels remain null and are covered by the owned suite.
